units.id: news:coalition merchant|"Jealous of you, I am. If a jump drive I had, bypass the gap between Saryd and Arach space, I could, and quickly earn a fortune, I would."|247|0
units.english: "Jealous of you, I am. If a jump drive I had, bypass the gap between Saryd and Arach space, I could, and quickly earn a fortune, I would."
units.italian: "Invidioso di te, sono. Se un jump drive avessi, aggirare la distanza tra lo spazio Saryd e quello Arach, potrei, e in fretta una fortuna guadagnare, guadagnerei."

units.id: news:coalition merchant|"Agreed to transport some Saryd graduates for a 'field trip,' I once did. Almost arrested, I was."|248|0
units.english: "Agreed to transport some Saryd graduates for a 'field trip,' I once did. Almost arrested, I was."
units.italian: "Accettato di trasportare alcuni laureati Saryd per una 'gita di studio', una volta ho fatto. Quasi arrestato, sono stato."

units.id: news:coalition merchant|"Used to fly with me, my brother did, but now become a Heliarch, he has."|250|0
units.english: "Used to fly with me, my brother did, but now become a Heliarch, he has."
units.italian: "Volare con me, mio fratello faceva, ma ora diventato un Heliarch, è."

units.id: news:arach civilian|"Arrested close to where my cousins work, the terrorists on the news were. Notice anything wrong with them, they never did."|261|0
units.english: "Arrested close to where my cousins work, the terrorists on the news were. Notice anything wrong with them, they never did."
units.italian: "Arrestati vicino a dove lavorano i miei cugini, i terroristi del notiziario erano. Notare niente di strano in loro, non l'hanno mai fatto."

units.id: news:arach civilian|"Always rising, the sun in these broadcasts is, but a night shift I work, so see it for myself, I never can..."|262|0
units.english: "Always rising, the sun in these broadcasts is, but a night shift I work, so see it for myself, I never can..."
units.italian: "Sempre a sorgere, il sole in queste trasmissioni è, ma di turno di notte lavoro, quindi vederlo con i miei occhi, non posso mai..."

units.id: news:arach civilian|"To Ring of Wisdom, a researcher friend of mine has gone. Always there, our wisest mingle, but remain here, few do. Difficult for us, sometimes it is."|263|0
units.english: "To Ring of Wisdom, a researcher friend of mine has gone. Always there, our wisest mingle, but remain here, few do. Difficult for us, sometimes it is."
units.italian: "A Ring of Wisdom, un mio amico ricercatore è andato. Sempre lì, i nostri più saggi si incontrano, ma restare qui, pochi lo fanno. Difficile per noi, a volte è."

units.id: news:arach civilian|"Always mixing up our Houses, Kimek and Saryd tourists are. Mind it, I do not, but angry, sometimes my friends get."|264|0
units.english: "Always mixing up our Houses, Kimek and Saryd tourists are. Mind it, I do not, but angry, sometimes my friends get."
units.italian: "Sempre a confondere le nostre Case, i turisti Kimek e Saryd stanno. Dargli peso, io non lo faccio, ma arrabbiati, a volte i miei amici si fanno."

units.id: news:arach civilian|"Learnt my language, some Kimek friends have, but so fast they speak, that difficult to understand them, it is."|265|0
units.english: "Learnt my language, some Kimek friends have, but so fast they speak, that difficult to understand them, it is."
units.italian: "Imparato la mia lingua, alcuni amici Kimek hanno, ma così in fretta parlano, che difficile capirli, è."

units.id: news:kimek civilian|"Tired of dealing with faulty translation boxes, my sister got, so learning to speak Arachi, she is."|279|0
units.english: "Tired of dealing with faulty translation boxes, my sister got, so learning to speak Arachi, she is."
units.italian: "Stanca di avere a che fare con traduttori difettosi, mia sorella si è, così imparare a parlare l'Arachi, sta."

units.id: news:kimek civilian|"Much more reserved than us, the Saryds are. So long do they live for, that difficult to understand their habits, it can be."|280|0
units.english: "Much more reserved than us, the Saryds are. So long do they live for, that difficult to understand their habits, it can be."
units.italian: "Molto più riservati di noi, i Saryd sono. Così a lungo vivono, che difficile capire le loro abitudini, può essere."

units.id: news:saryd civilian|"Troubling it is, when their children, Kimek and Arach tourists bring. Climb up everywhere, they try."|294|0
units.english: "Troubling it is, when their children, Kimek and Arach tourists bring. Climb up everywhere, they try."
units.italian: "Preoccupante è, quando i loro bambini, i turisti Kimek e Arach portano. Arrampicarsi ovunque, provano."

units.id: news:saryd civilian|"Travel to new places, I used to, but infinite, our planets are not, so seen them all by now I have."|295|0
units.english: "Travel to new places, I used to, but infinite, our planets are not, so seen them all by now I have."
units.italian: "Viaggiare in posti nuovi, ero solito, ma infiniti, i nostri pianeti non sono, quindi visti tutti ormai li ho."

units.id: news:coalition vendor|"Purchase some Saryd cakes, would you like to? Homemade, they are."|306|0
units.english: "Purchase some Saryd cakes, would you like to? Homemade, they are."
units.italian: "Comprare un po' di dolci Saryd, ti piacerebbe? Fatti in casa, sono."

units.id: news:coalition vendor|"Interested in this tapestry, are you? Of the finest longcow hide, it is made. A special discount, for you I could make."|307|0
units.english: "Interested in this tapestry, are you? Of the finest longcow hide, it is made. A special discount, for you I could make."
units.italian: "Interessato a questo arazzo, sei? Della più pregiata pelle di longcow, è fatto. Uno sconto speciale, per te potrei fare."

units.id: news:coalition vendor|"Interested in these ringworld keychains, are you? For you, only 30 credits!"|308|0
units.english: "Interested in these ringworld keychains, are you? For you, only 30 credits!"
units.italian: "Interessato a questi portachiavi del ringworld, sei? Per te, solo 30 crediti!"
